query:
SELECT c.channel_id FROM channels c
         WHERE c.workspace_id = $1 AND (
             c.type <> 'dm' OR EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM channel_invites ci
                 WHERE ci.channel_id = c.channel_id AND ci.user_id = $2
             )
         ) ORDER BY hashtext(c.channel_id),c.channel_id
